title: 달과 계절: 1월~12월, 봄 여름 가을 겨울
objective: By the end, you can name the four seasons, read and say the months, including 6월 (유월) and 10월 (시월), and use 달, 몇 월, and 다음 달 in short sentences.
summary: Learn the four seasons and key month words in Korean, including how to ask what month it is and how to say 6월 and 10월.

task.title: Use month and season words
task.line: Read each item and write the Korean word or short answer that fits.

words.exampleMeaning: In spring, lots of flowers bloom.
I'm going to the beach during summer vacation.
I like fall because it's cool.

words.meaning: month (when counting months: 한 달, 두 달, 세 달)
words.exampleMeaning: I studied Korean for three months.

words.meaning: what month (asking for a month name)
June (6월 is said 유월, not 육월)
words.exampleMeaning: I came to Korea in June.

words.meaning: October (10월 is said 시월, not 십월)
words.exampleMeaning: My friend is coming to Korea in October.
I'm going back to my hometown next month.

exercises: Write the season for these months in Korea: ① 7월, 8월 ② 10월, 11월 ③ 1월, 2월
Write how you say these months in Korean letters: ① 6월 ② 10월
Fill in the blank: A: 방학이 ____부터예요? B: 7월부터예요.
Choose 계절, 달, or 다음 달 for each blank: ① 지금은 9월이에요. ____에 시험이 있어요. ② 저는 한 ____에 책을 두 권 읽어요. ③ 제가 제일 좋아하는 ____은 봄이에요.
Read and write the season in Korean: ① 날씨가 아주 더워요. 바다에서 수영해요. ② 날씨가 따뜻하고 꽃이 많아요.
Answer about yourself in Korean: 무슨 계절을 좋아해요?
answers: ① 여름 ② 가을 ③ 겨울
① 다음 달 ② 달 ③ 계절
Answers will vary. Example: 저는 가을을 좋아해요. (저는 겨울을 좋아해요. / 봄을 좋아해요.)
